lead: How this realm's sign-in pages look: the sign-in screen and every step after it, consent, GNAP's interaction pages, the federation pages, sign-out, the front door and the user portal. The admin console keeps its own look. Everything here belongs to the realm {realm}.
customised.yes: This realm's appearance differs from the service's own.
customised.no: This realm looks as the service always has: nothing here has been changed.
readOnly: Changing the sign-in appearance needs Admin Write.
colours.heading: Colours
colours.lead: Four colours, saved together and judged together. Text and links below WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the card are refused, and then nothing is saved.
colour.cardHint: The card the form is drawn on.
contrast.heading: Contrast
derived.heading: Derived tones
derived.lead: Never set: each is computed from the four colours when a page is drawn. Button text is black or white, whichever reads better on the accent.
layout.heading: Layout and logo
layout.centered: Centered: the card alone, the logo at its top.
layout.split: Split: a brand panel beside the card, stacked above it on a narrow screen.
layout.banner: Banner: a band across the top carrying the logo, the card below it.
layout.displayNameHint: Shown beside the logo and in the page title. Never translated. Empty for none.
layout.logoAltHint: What a screen reader reads in the logo's place. Required while a logo is set.
layout.logoLinkHint: An https address the logo opens. Empty for none.
logo.heading: Logo
logo.none: This realm has no logo, and its sign-in pages show none.
logo.facts: {type}, {width} × {height} pixels, {bytes, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}}
logo.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, decided by the file's own bytes. Each side 16 to 2048 pixels, at most {max, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}}.
preview.heading: Preview
preview.lead: Opens this realm's sign-in card in a new tab with the colours and the layout below, before anything is saved. Nothing on it signs anybody in. The logo and the display name it shows are the saved ones.
preview.open: Open the preview in a new tab
